steps.text: Rest at the Gatefront or Agheel Lake North grace to meet her. Accept her request to receive the Spectral Steed Whistle (your mount) and the ability to level up.

If you've activated two different sites of grace in Limgrave (that are not underground), Melina can also be met at the Church of Elleh, Agheel Lake South, Seaside Ruins, Bridge of Sacrifice, Stormhill Shack, and the Third Church of Marika.
Exhaust her dialogue at The First Step, Church of Elleh, Stormhill Shack, or Castleward Tunnel.
Talk to her at a site of grace other than the one you chose in the previous step to learn about her purpose.
Talk to her at the Third Church of Marika grace.
Talk to her at the Church of Pilgrimage grace.
Defeat Margit, or rest at any grace outside of Limgrave and Weeping Peninsula, to receive her invitation to Roundtable Hold.
Talk to her at the East Raya Lucaria Gate grace.
Talk to her at the Grand Lift of Dectus grace.
Talk to her at a site of grace in Altus Plateau.
After giving Boc the Gold Sewing Needle and selecting "Surely she'd be happy for you?", talk to her at the Altus Highway Junction grace.
Talk to her at the Minor Erdtree Church grace to learn the Outer Order gesture.
Talk to her at the Outer Wall Battleground grace.
Melina leaves when you rest at the East Capital Rampart, Avenue Balcony, Lower Capital Church, or West Capital Rampart. You're unable to talk to her at any sites of grace while she's gone.
After inspecting the thorns protecting the Erdtree, rest at the nearby grace to reunite with her and receive the Rold Medallion.
Talk to her at any site of grace after asking Enia how to burn the thorns.
Talk to her at the Queen's Bedchamber grace.
Talk to her at the Cathedral of the Forsaken grace.
Talk to her at the Frenzied Flame Proscription grace.
Talk to her at any grace after exhausting Shabriri's dialogue near Zamor Ruins.
Talk to her twice at the First Church of Marika grace. The second dialogue can be heard at any grace in the mountaintops past the church.
Talk to her at the Forge of the Giants grace and tell her that you're ready.
Roll into the yellow shrub southeast of Agheel Lake North to reveal him. Exhaust his dialogue to receive Mushroom x10.
Talk to him next to the grace in Coastal Cave.
Kill the Demi-Human Chiefs in the cave to retrieve his Sewing Needle.
Return to him by the grace and give him the needle.
Talk to him at the Lake-Facing Cliffs grace and select "Don't tell me...".
Talk to him at the East Raya Lucaria Gate grace.
Loot the Gold Sewing Needle from a chest in the Church of Vows.
After killing Radahn, buy Radahn's Lion Armor from Enia.

Talk to Boc at the Altus Highway Junction and select "I'm sorry...". Give him the golden needle, then select "I have a favor to ask" and "You may call me lord" to learn the My Lord gesture. Optionally, select "Surely she'd be happy for you?" to unlock dialogue with Melina at the grace.
Loot Prattling Pate "You're beautiful" from the porch of a house in Hermit Village.
Boc will show up at the East Capital Rampart after resting there. You'll have a few options to finish his questline:
Note: If you see the dialogue option "What do you really think?", selecting this without giving him a Larval Tear will cause him to die outside Rennala's room.
Give him a Larval Tear:
Talk to him and select "Have you ever thought so?", then give him a Larval Tear.
Talk to him and select "Please wait".
Interact with him in the Raya Lucaria Grand Library, then reload the area to find him dead.
Use Prattling Pate "You're beautiful":
Use it in front of him, then select "I heard a voice" and answer "That's right". He'll remain there for the rest of the playthrough, altering your garments for free.
Talk to him on top of an arched ruin above the path west of the Third Church of Marika.
Kill the Godrick Knight in Fort Haight, then return to him to receive the Erdsteel Dagger. Exhaust his dialogue and pledge service to him.
Return to the fort and talk to him where the knight was.
After completing Nepheli's questline, talk to him beside the throne in Stormveil Castle.
Exhaust her dialogue in a side room next to the path that leads to the boss of Stormveil Castle.
After killing Godrick and Gideon Ofnir has moved to his study, exhaust her dialogue in Roundtable Hold. If you talked to her in Stormveil Castle, you'll receive the (missable) Arsenal Charm.
Talk to her on the slope leading up to the Village of the Albinaurics.
After killing the Omenkiller in the village, talk to her down the stairs in Roundtable Hold.
After speaking to Gideon Ofnir about Nepheli's despair, talk to Nepheli and select "I heard from Gideon", then talk to her again.
Loot an Imbued Sword Key from the chest at the top of the hill with the Four Belfries.
Unlock the imp-sealed belfry marked with the message "Precipice of Anticipation":
Pick up The Stormhawk King past the side entrance of the chapel where you started out.
Upon returning to Nepheli in Roundtable Hold (after accepting Seluvis's task in Caria Manor), you'll have two options:
Give her Seluvis's Potion:
Note: Turns her into a puppet, preventing completion of her, Gostoc's, and Kenneth Haight's questlines.
After receiving the Carian Inverted Statue from Ranni, loot the Nepheli Loux Puppet from Pidia's corpse in Caria Manor.
Give her the Stormhawk King:
Note: You need to progress Roderika's questline up until she becomes a spirit tuner for this option to be available.
After killing Morgott, exhaust her dialogue in Stormveil Castle's throne room to receive an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Talk to him at the entrance to Stormveil Castle.

When entering from the side entrance, he appears in four locations and begins stealing 30% of your runes each time you die in the castle. Talk to him in one of these locations to receive a Grace Mimic and unlock his inventory:
#1: On a ledge above the Stormveil Cliffside grace. He spawns after entering the castle's first floor room via the side entrance. [ Location 1 ]
#2: In the first floor room near the Hookclaws. He spawns after climbing the ladder past the locked door. [ Location 2 ]
#3: On the chapel roof above Rogier. He spawns after entering the dark room with the Grafted Scion. [ Location 3 ]
To stop him from stealing your runes, talk to him in one of the three locations above, then talk to him in the fourth:
#4: Next to the Rampart Tower lift. He spawns after reaching the stairs that lead to the chapel roof if you've cleared his path of enemies. [ Location 4 ]
Talk to him in the arena after killing Godrick and resting at the grace.
After completing Nepheli's questline, exhaust his dialogue in the throne room to unlock an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone for sale.
Talk to her in Stormhill Shack to learn the Sitting Sideways gesture, then exhaust her dialogue for the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes.
Note: Both can also be obtained in Roundtable Hold after she becomes a spirit tuner. Simply talk to her there, then select "Please".
Retrieve the Chrysalid's Memento from Stormveil Castle, then give it to her and exhaust her dialogue.
After giving her the memento or activating a grace in Liurnia, she relocates to Roundtable Hold. Talk to her in front of the fireplace.
Note: If you gave her the memento, she'll reward you with a Golden Seed. Otherwise, you'll find it at Stormhill Shack.
After speaking to Hewg about Roderika, talk to her and tell her what the blacksmith said.
Talk to Hewg about Roderika, then ask if he'll watch over her; your answer doesn't matter. Reload the area and she'll be a spirit tuner.
Her Crimson Hood can now be found in Stormveil Castle, where the Chrysalid's Memento was.
Upgrade any spirit ash to +4, then select "Talk" to learn the Curtsy gesture.
At various points during Dung Eater's questline, she'll have optional dialogue:
After activating a grace in Altus Plateau, talk to her and select "There's something you should know".
After releasing Dung Eater from his cell, talk to her about the spirit's voices.
After defeating Dung Eater in the outer moat, talk to her and select "Please take care".
After exhausting Dung Eater's dialogue in Roundtable Hold, talk to her about the spirits' voices once more.
After burning the Erdtree, talk to her in front of the fireplace.
After asking Hewg why he's still making weapons, talk to her about Hewg.
After killing Maliketh and speaking to Hewg about himself, talk to Roderika about what's happened to Hewg, then exhaust her dialogue option.
Ask him about the chains on his legs and if he's a prisoner.
After defeating a Shardbearer, talk to him and he'll comment that you've felled your mark. Reload the area, then talk to him about his prayer.
After Roderika arrives at Roundtable Hold, talk to him about Roderika.
After telling Roderika what the blacksmith said, talk to him about Roderika, then ask if he'll watch over her; your answer doesn't matter.
After she becomes a spirit tuner, talk to him about Roderika.
After learning the Curtsy gesture, talk to him about Roderika.
After burning the Erdtree and speaking to Roderika in front of the fireplace, ask him why he's still making weapons.
After speaking to Roderika about Hewg, ask him what happened to her.
After killing the Godskin Duo, exhaust his dialogue about the god-slaying weapon.
After killing Maliketh, talk to Hewg about himself.
Interact with him at Roundtable Hold to learn the What Do You Want? gesture.

After obtaining the first half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion, he'll attempt to ambush you in Roundtable Hold. Kill him to obtain the Clinging Bone, then pick up the Royal Remains Set outside Gideon's study.
Meet him in Roundtable Hold and exhaust his dialogue.
After exhausting his dialouge in the central room, he moves to his study. Exhaust his dialogue there.
After defeating a Shardbearer, he'll provide information about the located demigods.
After obtaining the first half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion, talk to him about Ensha twice to hear Latenna's location.

After obtaining Seluvis's Potion, you can give it to him to safely progress Nepheli's, Dung Eater's, and Seluvis's questlines, but you will miss out on the Nepheli Loux Puppet or Dung Eater Puppet until your next playthrough.
After activating a grace in Leyndell, talk to him about the unlocated demigods.
Talk to him after killing Morgott to ask where you should go.
After obtaining the second half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion, tell him that the secret medallions are reunited.
After activating a grace in Mohgwyn Palace, talk to him about Mohgwyn Palace to receive Fevor's Cookbook [3].
After killing Mohg, talk to him about the Lord of Blood's cocoon to receive Law of Causality.
After activating a grace in Miquella's Haligtree, talk to him about using the secret medallions to receive Black Flame's Protection.
After killing Malenia, talk to him about the Haligtree roots to receive Lord's Divine Fortification.
After burning the Erdtree, talk to him and exhaust his dialogue option.
After killing Maliketh, he appears as a mandatory boss in the Erdtree Sanctuary. Kill him for the Scepter of the All-Knowing and the All-Knowing Set.
Talk to Albus, disguised as a glowing pot, in the Village of the Albinaurics to receive the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right).
Talk to Gideon Ofnir about Ensha twice to hear Latenna's location.
Talk to her at the end of Lakeside Crystal Cave and show her the secret medallion. Hear her request, then talk to her again to receive Latenna the Albinauric.
Summon her in front of Phillia, Towering Little Sister at the Apostate Derelict, then talk to her to receive a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Meet her next to the road past the Bridge of Sacrifice. Exhaust her dialogue, then agree to deliver her letter to receive Irina's Letter.
Talk to Edgar in Castle Morne to receive a Sacrificial Twig, then deliver him Irina's Letter.
Kill Leonine Misbegotten to retrieve the Grafted Blade Greatsword.
Return to Edgar and exhaust his dialouge.
Talk to Edgar next to Irina's corpse at the roadside past the Bridge of Sacrifice.
Kill Edgar at Revenger's Shack for Shabriri Grape, Banished Knight's Halberd+8, and Raw Meat Dumpling x5.
Grab the 5x Raw Meat Dumpling inside the Revenger's Shack; they only spawn if Edgar invades.
Appears at the Lake-Facing Cliffs after Irina dies. Progress her questline by giving her Shabriri Grapes, which can be obtained in these locations:
#1: At the bottom of Stormveil Castle's throne room, also accessible through a back door east of the Lake-Facing Cliffs grace.
#2: Next to a chest in the underground cellar in Purified Ruins.
#3: Obtained after killing Edgar the Revenger at Revenger's Shack.
Give her a grape at the Lake-Facing Cliffs to learn the As You Wish gesture.
Give her a grape at the shore near Purified Ruins.
Give her a grape near the Gate Town Bridge and answer that they're human eyes. Reload the area, then exhaust her dialogue.
Approach the Church of Inhibition to be invaded by Festering Fingerprint Vyke. Kill him to obtain a Fingerprint Grape and Vyke's War Spear.
Give her the Fingerprint Grape in Bellum Church.
Talk to her at the Frenzied Flame Proscription.
Unequip your armor, then open the charred door to inherit the frenzied flame.
Touch her with the flame and exhaust her dialogue until she catches fire, dropping the Frenzied Flame Seal and Frenzyflame Stone x5.
Exhaust his dialogue at The First Step grace.
Talk to him after visiting Roundtable Hold. Answer "I'll fly straight and true!", then exhaust his dialogue.
Talk to him after killing a Shardbearer.
After talking to Enia in Roundtable Hold, read the glowing message at The First Step to learn the Bravo! gesture.
Talk to him at Rose Church. Answer that the Two Fingers didn't seem right, then talk to him again for Festering Bloody Finger x5.
If this is the first time you obtain a Festering Bloody Finger, you will also receive About Invasion Multiplayer.
Invade Magnus the Beast Claw in Writheblood Ruins (if you can't kill him, dying to him three times will also work).
Note: If you're playing online, you can skip this step by invading another player three times. The outcome of the invasion doesn't matter.
Talk to him and answer "Anoint me" to receive the Lord of Blood's Favor.
Interact with or kill one of the following maidens to soak the Lord of Blood's Favor in blood:
The deceased maiden in the Church of Inhibition.
The deceased maiden in the Chapel of Anticipation.
Irina, or Hyetta (if she has spawned), at any of their locations.
Offer him your finger to receive a Bloody Finger, then talk to him to obtain the Pureblood Knight's Medal.
Invade Varre at the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint for a Rune Arc and Furlcalling Finger Remedy, then exhaust his dialogue for Festering Bloody Finger x6 and Varre's Bouquet.

Note: You can get a second Varre's Bouquet if you quit out instead of picking up his loot. You should then see an additional pickup. Grab that one first, then pick up Varre's usual loot. [ See video ]
First met in Roundtable Hold after defeating a Shardbearer. Talk to her to have audience with the Two Fingers, and optionally, talk to her about Great Runes.
Talk to her after defeating two Shardbearers to receive a Talisman Pouch. Optionally, talk to her about Queen Marika.
After killing Morgott, tell her that you want to burn the impenetrable thorns, then ask how to burn thorns.
Talk to her after burning the Erdtree.
Encountered in Bestial Sanctum. Progress his quest by feeding him a total of 9 Deathroots, which can be obtained in these locations:
#1: Received after killing the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village.
#2: In a chest at the end of Deathtouched Catacombs.
#3: Received after killing the Tibia Mariner in eastern Liurnia.
#4: In a chest at the end of Black Knife Catacombs.
#5: Received after killing the Tibia Mariner in Wyndham Ruins.
#6: In a chest at the end of Gelmir Hero's Grave.
#7: In a chest at the end of Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs.
#8: Received after killing the Tibia Mariner on the cliff overlooking Castle Sol.
#9: In a chest at the bottom of the Hidden Path to the Haligtree.
Feed him one Deathroot to receive Clawmark Seal and Beast Eye.
Feed him a second Deathroot to receive Bestial Sling.
Feed him a third Deathroot to receive Bestial Vitality.
Feed him a fourth Deathroot to receive Ash of War: Beast's Roar.
After reloading the area, he'll enter a frenzy. Hit him a few times to snap him out of it, then talk to him (or rest at the grace if you can't).
Feed him a fifth Deathroot to receive Beast Claw.
Feed him a sixth Deathroot to receive Stone of Gurranq.
Feed him a seventh Deathroot to receive Beastclaw Greathammer.
Feed him an eight Deathroot to receive Gurranq's Beast Claw.
Feed him a ninth Deathroot to receive an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Talk to him on the left side of the road past Saintsbridge.
After killing the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village, talk to him near the village entrance (or in Roundtable Hold) and accept his introduction.
Use the sending gate marked on your map to reach Bestial Sanctum. Talk to Gurranq inside and feed him any Deathroots you may have.
Talk to him in Roundtable Hold, and if you've interacted with Gurranq, talk to D about himself.
After speaking with Rogier in Roundtable Hold, talk to D about Rogier.
Give him the Weathered dagger received from Fia. Reload the area and loot D's Bell Bearing and the Twinned Set from his corpse.
Interact with him in Siofra Aqueduct to learn the Inner Order gesture. If you have the Twinned Set, you'll need to hand it over first.
Note: If you got the set from killing his brother, the next step is skipped and you'll need to reload the area and kill him for his loot.

After giving him the full Twinned Set and finishing Fia's questline, he'll show up next to her corpse. Talk to him, then reload the area to find the Inseparable Sword and the Twinned Set on the ground.
Talk to her in Roundtable Hold and let her hold you twice. During the second embrace, choose to talk in secret.
After speaking with Rogier about the corpse under Stormveil, let her hold you, then select "Do you know...?" and "About the Black Knifeprint" to receive the Knifeprint Clue.
After giving Rogier the Black Knifeprint, let her hold you, then talk to her about Rogier to receive a Sacrificial Twig.
After triggering the Radahn festival, let her hold you and select "May I ask a favor?" to receive the Weathered Dagger.
Give the dagger to D, Hunter of the Dead, then reload the area and talk to Fia in a newly opened room in the east wing.
After receiving the Carian Inverted Statue from Ranni, loot the Cursemark of Death from Ranni's corpse at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia.
Defeat Fia's Champions at the top of Deeproot Depths.
Speak to her and answer that you want to be held. Talk to her in secret twice, then give her the Cursemark of Death to receive the Radiant Baldachin's Blessing.

Talk to her in secret and reload the area. Talk to her again and reload the area a second time. Interact with her afterward to enter the Deathbed Dream, then kill Lichdragon Fortissax inside the dream.
Loot the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince from her corpse, then reload the area to pick up Fia's Set.
Talk to him in the chapel past the Stormhawks in Stormveil Castle and answer that you're here to defeat Godrick.
Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit in Stormveil Castle's underground crypt to unlock his dialogue about the corpse under Stormveil.
After killing Godrick, he relocates to the balcony in Roundtable Hold:
Tell him that you've defeated Godrick to receive Rogier's Rapier+8.
Talk to him about the corpse under Stormveil to unlock dialogue about the black knifeprints with Fia.
Talk to him about D and he'll additionally drop Rogier's Letter when he dies, detailing the location of D, Hunter of the Dead's brother.
Kill the Black Knife Assassin behind an illusory wall in Black Knife Catacombs to obtain the Black Knifeprint.
Give him the Black Knifeprint, then talk to him after reloading the area. Optionally, talk to him about Ranni's whereabouts, why he wants a cursemark, and about D.
Locate Ranni at the top of Ranni's Rise and exhaust her dialogue until she tells you to leave.
Tell him that Ranni cast off her cursemark, then return to Ranni and enter her service.

Speak with him and select "Talk" to hear that his condition is worsening. Reload the area and talk to him in his unresponsive state, then reload the area three more times to find him dead. Loot Rogier's Bell Bearing and the Spellblade's Set from his corpse.
Note: He'll also drop Rogier's Letter if you talked to him about D, and Rogier's Rapier+8 if you didn't get it earlier.
After unlocking Torrent, you'll find her at the Church of Elleh. Tell her you can call the spectral steed to receive Spirit Calling Bell and Lone Wolf Ashes.
After Rogier has examined the Black Knifeprint, exhaust Ranni's dialogue at the top of Ranni's Rise until she tells you to leave:
Note: If you see the dialogue option "No particular reason", then selecting it and answering her question will end Rogier's questline.
Return to Rogier and tell him that Ranni cast off her cursemark, then ask Ranni to enter her service.
After entering her service, greet her other vassals in the tower:
Talk to Iji's projection until you've exhausted his dialogue.
Talk to Blaidd's projection.
Talk to Seluvis's projection.
Talk to her after greeting her vassals; if you rest at the grace, this dialogue is skipped.
Loot the Fingerslayer Blade from a chest underneath the massive throne in Night's Sacred Ground.
Exhaust her dialogue to receive the Carian Inverted Statue.
Note: Keep in mind that doing this will end Seluvis's questline, so make sure you're done with him first.
Her other tower, Renna's Rise, will now be open. Use the sending gate inside to reach Ainsel River Main. After arriving, pick up Miniature Ranni from one of the coffins.
Talk to the miniature Ranni three times while resting at any of the three sites of grace in Nokstella to get a response from her.
Talk to her while resting at the Nokstella, Eternal City grace.
Talk to her while resting at the Nokstella Waterfall Basin grace.
Kill the Baleful Shadow past the Nokstella Waterfall Basin to receive the Discarded Palace Key.
Unlock the chest in the Raya Lucaria Grand Library to obtain the Dark Moon Ring.
Drop down the hole in Cathedral of Manus Celes and place the ring on her finger. Talk to her afterward to receive the Dark Moon Greatsword.
Talk to her while resting at the Ranni's Chamber grace at the top of Ranni's Rise.
Hear his howling in Mistwood Ruins.
Talk to Kale in Church of Elleh about the howling in Mistwood to learn the Finger Snap gesture.
Use the Finger Snap gesture below Blaidd in Mistwood Ruins, then talk to him after he jumps down.
Return to Kale and talk to him about Blaidd.
Kill Bloodhound Knight Darriwil in Forlorn Hound Evergaol with or without Blaidd's help.
Talk to him after the fight to receive a Somber Smithing Stone [2], then speak with him again to unlock a talisman for sale later.
Enter Ranni's service, then (if you have not yet killed Radahn) talk to him in Ranni's Rise.
Talk to him at the cliff east of the Siofra River Bank:
Ask Seluvis about Nokron to receive Seluvis's Introduction, then show the letter to Sellen in Waypoint Ruins.
Return to Blaidd and tell him Sellen's story. You can also tell him Iji's story if you've spoken to both Jerren and Iji about each other.
Talk to him in Redmane Castle during the Radahn festival.
After killing Radahn, talk to him on the dune with the site of grace.
Talk to him in Forlorn Hound Evergoal. You can release him, but it won't change the outcome.
After obtaining the Dark Moon Ring and killing Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, he goes mad outside Ranni's Rise. Kill him to obtain the Royal Greatsword and Blaidd's Set.
First met at the Road to the Manor. Talk to him multiple times, then select "Please take care" and "Talk".

If you exhausted Blaidd's dialogue after killing Bloodhound Knight Darriwil, tell Iji that Blaidd sent you to unlock the Carian Filigreed Crest for purchase. Otherwise, it'll be available after entering Ranni's service.
After entering Ranni's service, exhaust his dialogue in Ranni's Rise.
After speaking with all three of Ranni's vassals, talk to him about Nokron and about Blaidd.
After speaking to Jerren about Iji in Redmane Castle, talking to Iji about Jerren afterward will initialize the Radahn festival.
After killing Radahn, speak to him about Jerren and select "Talk".
After speaking with Blaidd in Forlorn Hound Evergaol, ask Iji why Blaidd is in the Evergaol.
After receiving the Carian Inverted Statue from Ranni, speak to him and select "Talk".
After finishing Blaidd's questline, inform him of Blaidd's death. Reload the area to find Iji's Bell Bearing and Iji's Mirrorhelm on his anvil.
After entering Ranni's service, talk to him in Ranni's Rise.
Talk to him in Seluvis's Rise and accept his task to receive Seluvis's Potion.
At this point, you'll have three options:
Give the potion to Nepheli. [ Refer to Nepheli's questline ]
Give the potion to Dung Eater. [ Refer to Dung Eater's questline ]
Give the potion to Gideon Ofnir. [ Refer to Gideon Ofnir's questline ]
Disposing of the potion unlocks Seluvis's inventory. If you gave the potion to Dung Eater or Gideon Ofnir, you can talk to Seluvis about Nepheli.
Find his puppet chamber in a hidden cellar in the ruins northeast of Ranni's Rise. Interact with the message there that reads: "Seluvis' Puppet. Do not touch".
Talk to him about his chambers to receive a puppet for free.
Quit and reload your game twice to unlock the next dialogue option, then tell him that you want a new puppet.
Buy one puppet, then talk to him about the scheme and respond that you're interested.
Loot an Amber Starlight from a small area northeast of the Altus Highway Junction grace.
Give him the Amber Starlight, then talk to him to receive the Magic Scorpion Charm.

Reload the area and talk to him to receive the Amber Draught. You can talk to him about the draught, but attempting to administer it will anger Ranni and cause his death. If you don't want to anger Ranni, he'll die once you exhaust her dialogue after having obtained the Fingerslayer Blade.
Loot Seluvis's Bell Bearing and the Preceptor's Set from his puppet-like corpse, then grab Pidia's Bell Bearing and Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet from Pidia's corpse.
Note: If you gave Seluvis's potion to Nepheli, Pidia will drop the Nepheli Loux Puppet instead.
Talk to her in the cellar at Waypoint Ruins. Answer "I want to learn sorcery", then "I still want to learn" to receive the Nod In Thought gesture.
Interact with Primeval Sorcerer Azur in the area past Hermit Village to receive Comet Azur.
Show her Azur's sorcery, then select "Tell me your story", "Let us journey together", and "I have a favor to ask" to receive the Sellian Sealbreaker.
Interact with Primeval Sorcerer Lusat behind a seal at the bottom of Sellia Hideaway to receive Stars of Ruin.
Tell her Lusat's location to receive Starlight Shards.
After killing Radahn, talk to her about the request.
Talk to her real body in the cellar at Witchbane Ruins and accept her primal glintstone to obtain Sellen's Primal Glintstone.
After Jerren has left Redmane Castle, transplant her primal glintstone into her puppet in the hidden cellar northeast of Ranni's Rise.
Use the gold summon sign outside the Raya Lucaria Grand Library and help her kill Jerren for the Eccentric's Set.
Exhaust her dialogue in the library to receive the Glintstone Kris.
Reload the area to find her turned into a sorcerer ball. Pick up the Witch's Glintstone Crown next to her.
Pick up Lusat's Set in Sellia Hideaway and Azur's Set near Hermit Village.
Can be met in Redmane Castle before the festival. Talking to him about Iji, then speaking to Iji about Jerren will initialize the Radahn festival.
During the Radahn festival, talk to him and select "Ready as I'll ever be". Exhaust his dialogue after the cutscene to learn the Heartening Cry gesture.
Note: If missed, you can repeat the step by quickly traveling to Roundtable Hold and back.
Exhaust his dialogue in Redmane Castle after killing Radahn.
After accepting Sellen's primal glintstone, talk to him in the cellar at Witchbane Ruins.

After transplanting Sellen's primal glintstone into a puppet, use the red summon sign outside the Raya Lucaria Grand Library and help him kill Sellen for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Sellen's Bell Bearing, and Witch's Glintstone Crown.
Talk to him outside the library to receive an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
First met at Gowry's Shack in Caelid. Talk to him and hear his request.
Kill Commander O'Neil south-southeast of Inner Aeonia to obtain the Unalloyed Gold Needle.
Give him the needle to receive Sellia's Secret, then reload the area to get the Unalloyed Gold Needle back.
Talk to him after giving the repaired needle to Millicent. If she is there instead of him, simply talk to her, then reload the area. Make sure to tell him that Millicent paid a visit.
After giving Millicent the Valkyrie's Prosthesis, tell him that you gave Millicent the prosthesis, then talk to him about Millicent.
Buy Pest Threads from him, then talk to him about Malenia to learn the Desperate Prayer gesture.
After exhausting Millicent's dialogue in the Prayer Room, tell him what Millicent said.
After killing the Putrid Tree Spirit in the rot pond and Millicent's summon signs appear, ask him why he's crying, then select "Become a flower?".
If you helped Millicent fend off her sisters, kill him for the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing. Otherwise, loot them from his corpse.
Millicent invades you southwest of Inner Aeonia. Defeat her for Sacramental Bud x5, Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [5], and a Golden Rune [10].
Find her at the Church of the Plague and give her the repaired needle from Gowry. Reload the area, then talk to her to receive the Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom.
Talk to her at Gowry's Shack.
Talk to her at the Erdtree-Gazing Hill in Altus Plateau.
Loot the Valkyrie's Prosthesis from a chest in The Shaded Castle and give it to her.
Talk to her at the top of Dominula, Windmill Village after killing the Godskin Apostle there.
Exhaust her dialogue at the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins.
Exhaust her dialogue in the Prayer Room.
After killing the Putrid Tree Spirit in the rot pond ahead of the Drainage Channel, you'll see two summon signs on the nearby ledge:
Challenge Millicent:
Note: By choosing this option, you lock yourself out of being able to remove the frenzied flame.
Use the red summon sign and kill Millicent for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and Millicent's Prosthesis.
Assist Millicent:
Use the gold summon sign and help Millicent kill her sisters to receive the Rotten Winged Sword Insignia.
Exhaust Millicent's dialogue next to the pond. Reload the area and loot the Unalloyed Gold Needle from her corpse.
After killing Malenia, return the needle to Malenia's scarlet bloom to receive Miquella's Needle and a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Talk to him in Roundtable Hold and answer "I see it" to learn the Prayer gesture.
After obtaining two Great Runes, speak to him and select "Talk".
Talk to him after activating a grace in Altus Plateau to trigger him to leave.
Find him next to the map stele in Altus Plateau. Talk to him about the noble Goldmask.
Find Goldmask at the end of the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge and interact with him.
Return to Corhyn and tell him Goldmask's whereabouts.
Talk to Corhyn next to Goldmask at the end of the bridge. Optionally, talk to him about the noble Goldmask.
Find them on a hill near the Leyndell colosseum and talk to Corhyn about the noble Goldmask.
After picking up the Golden Order Principia from the upper floor of the Erdtree Sanctuary, give it to Miriel and buy Law of Regression for 10,000 runes.
Exhaust Miriel's dialogue about Radagon for a hint about the next step.
Reach 37 Int by equipping intelligence-boosting gear, then use Law of Regression in front of the Radagon statue past the lift near the Erdtree Sanctuary.
Interact with Goldmask near the colosseum and tell him that Radagon is Marika to learn the Golden Order Totality gesture.
Talk to Corhyn immediately afterward to unlock Immutable Shield for sale. Optionally, talk to him about the noble Goldmask.
Talk to him on the bridge south of Stargazers' Ruins and exhaust his dialogue about the noble Goldmask.
Note: You can offer him the Tonic of Forgetfulness if you have it. He'll refuse but remain on the bridge instead of moving to Leyndell; it has no other effect.
After killing Maliketh, talk to Corhyn next to the giant spear in Leyndell. Reload the area to pick up Corhyn's Bell Bearing, Flail, and Corhyn's Robe.
Note: If you offered him the tonic, he'll be on the bridge in Mountaintops of the Giants instead.
On a ledge below Leyndell Colosseum sits Goldmask's corpse holding the Mending Rune of Perfect Order. Reload the area and pick up Goldmask's Set from the corpse.
Although there are a total of 6 Seedbed Curses, only 5 are needed to complete his quest:
#1: At the bottom of a dark room at the end of Volcano Manor, requiring two Stonesword Keys.
On the top floor of the building with the collapsed roof in Leyndell.
#3: In Fortified Manor (where Dung Eater usually sits). In the ashen capital it can be found near Gransax's feet outside the manor.
Looted from Blackguard's corpse after finishing his quest.
#5: In the room with three Crystalians, reached via a flying buttress near the room with two Cleanrot Knights in Elphael.
#6: On a ledge overlooking the area with ballistas in Elphael, reached via a flying buttress near a gazebo.
Appears in Roundtable Hold after activating a grace in Altus Plateau. Talk to him after obtaining a Seedbed Curse to receive the Sewer-Gaol Key.
Unlock his cell in Subterranean Shunning-Grounds and tell him to leave his gaol.
Read the message at his location in Roundtable Hold.
He'll invade when you approach the outer moat. Defeat him to obtain the Sword of Milos.
If you've followed Blackguard's questline, exhaust his dialogue in the moat. Reload the area and exhaust his dialogue again to obtain a Seedbed Curse.
Exhaust his dialogue back in Roundtable Hold.
Return to his physical body in the sewers, where you'll have two options:
Use the Seedbed Curses:
Loot the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse from his corpse to unlock the Blessing of Despair ending.

links.label: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse

steps.text: Reload the area and loot the Omen Set from his corpse.
Administer Seluvis's Potion:
Note: Turns him into a puppet, locking you out of the Blessing of Despair ending (not required for all achievements).
Kill him after giving him the potion to obtain the Omen Set, but do it before reloading the area as that will despawn him.
Progress Seluvis's questline up until you can buy puppets from him, then buy the Dung Eater Puppet.
After hearing Rya's request, talk to him and buy Rya's Necklace from him.
Buy one Boiled Prawn to learn the Spread Out gesture. Optionally, select "About Rya" and "Talk".
After resting in Altus Plateau, talk to him near the outer moat. Select "You should probably know...", then talk about the Dung Eater.
After releasing Dung Eater from his cell, talk to Blackguard about the Dung Eater.
Exhaust his dialogue after reloading the area, then loot the Seedbed Curse, Blackguard's Bell Bearing, Iron Ball and Blackguard's Iron Mask from his corpse.
Talk to her in the building next to the telescope in Liurnia and hear her request.
Buy back her necklace from Blackguard at Boilprawn Shack.
Return the necklace to her to receive the Volcano Manor Invitation.
Depending on how you enter Altus Plateau, she'll either be at the Grand Lift of Dectus or in the lower Lux Ruins. Accept her invitation to Volcano Manor.
Talk to her in the drawing room after joining the Volcano Manor.
After killing Istvan, talk to her about strange sounds beyond the walls.
Reload the area, then unlock the room opposite the drawing room to discover her serpentine form and talk to her.
Speak to Tanith about Zorayas's form.
After killing Rileigh, talk to her about a serpent she saw enter the neighboring room and never come out.
Speak to Tanith about Zorayas's troubles.
Hit the illusory wall in the room next to Rya's to reveal a path to Prison Town Church. Open the door past the grace, then tell Rya about the dark side of Volcano Manor.
After killing the Godskin Noble, pick up the Serpent's Amnion from the altar and give it to her.
Reload the area and speak to Tanith about Zorayas's absence. Talk to her again to receive the Tonic of Forgetfulness.
Beyond the Temple of Eiglay, find her in a small room past an Abductor Virgin. You'll then have three options:
Give Tonic of Forgetfulness:
Tell Tanith that you gave Rya the potion.
After killing Rykard and all NPCs in the manor have left, talk to Rya in the drawing room.
Reload the area and pick up Daedicar's Woe from the floor.
Kill her:
She turns back into a snake and drops Daedicar's Woe.
Tell Tanith that Zorayas is dead.
Do nothing:
After killing Rykard, exhaust her dialogue without giving her the tonic.
Reload the area to find Zorayas's Letter and Daedicar's Woe at her spot.
Talk to her and agree to join the Volcano Manor to receive the Drawing-Room Key.
Pick up the Letter from Volcano Manor on the table in the drawing room, then talk to her about the letter.
After killing Istvan (marked on your map), talk to her to receive Magma Shot.
Pick up the new Letter from Volcano Manor on the drawing room table.
After killing Rileigh (marked on your map), talk to her to receive the Serpentbone Blade.
Pick up the Red Letter on the drawing room table.
After killing Juno Hoslow (marked on your map), talk to her to receive the Taker's Cameo. She'll also offer to take you to Rykard.
Exhaust her dialogue after killing Rykard.
Speak to her in Rykard's arena. You can give her the castanets from Patches, but it has no effect except losing the item.
Kill her to be invaded by her knight, then kill him to obtain Aspects of the Crucible: Breath.
Loot the Consort's Set from her corpse.
Attacks after opening a chest in Murkwater Cave. Bring his HP below 50% and he'll surrender, giving you Golden Rune [1] x2 and the Grovel for Mercy gesture.
Talk to him after the fight; your answer doesn't matter.

Remove your weapon and punch him until he becomes hostile. Let him attack you until you're almost dead and he'll give you the Extreme Repentance gesture. Using it in front of him or letting him kill you will make him friendly again. This gesture can be obtained at three of Patches's locations: Murkwater Cave, Scenic Isle, or Mt. Gelmir.
Reload the area and talk to him about the bandits, then about the new chest.
Open the trap chest, then after resting at a site of grace, return to Patches to learn the Calm Down! gesture.

Talk to him at the Scenic Isle, selecting "Speaking of" and "Talk". After dying to the grab attack of the Abductor Virgin in the academy, you can return to him to receive the Calm Down! gesture (if not obtained).
Find him behind a rugged ledge near the tower west of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite. Talk to him and inspect the rainbow stones on the cliff edge.
Talk to him after being kicked off the cliff edge to receive the Calm Down! gesture (if not obtained).
After joining the Volcano Manor, he'll set up shop in the entrance hallway. Talk to him about himself.
After getting your first reward from Tanith, talk to him to receive the Letter to Patches.
After killing Tragoth (marked on your map), tell him the request is done. Reload the area, then ask about your reward to receive the Magma Whip Candlestick.
Note: Killing Tragoth will lock you out of obtaining the Casual Greeting gesture if you don't already have it.
Talk to him after killing Rykard to make him leave the manor.
Talk to him in the covered walkway leading to the Shaded Castle boss room to receive the Dancer's Castanets.
Loot his chest in Murkwater Cave. Upon recognizing you, he'll surrender and give you the Patches' Crouch gesture.
Talk to him in Warmaster's Shack to unlock his inventory; it doesn't matter what you answer. Optionally, select "Talk".
Talk to him in the drawing room after joining the Volcano Manor and answer that you understand.
After killing Istvan, talk to him to unlock his inventory again. Optionally, select "Talk".
After killing Rileigh, talk to him to receive the Letter to Bernahl.
After killing Vargram (marked on your map), talk to him to receive Gelmir's Fury.
Talk to him after killing Rykard to make him leave the manor.
He will invade you on the bridge north of the one leading up to Maliketh. Kill him to receive Blasphemous Claw, Devourer's Scepter, and the Beast Champion Set.
Talk to him in Roundtable Hold.
Talk to him on the outskirts of Academy Gate Town.
Talk to him back at Roundtable Hold.
After joining the Volcano Manor, exhaust his dialogue in the drawing room.
After killing Istvan, talk to him after reloading the area twice.
After killing Rileigh, walk in on him berating himself and talk to him.
Diallos relocates to Jarburg if Jar-Bairn's dialogue has been exhausted. Talk to Diallos in one of the shacks there.
Reload the area five times to trigger the village attack. Talk to Jar-Bairn and the dying Diallos; it doesn't matter how you respond.
Reload the area and talk to Jar-Bairn as he collects Diallos's remains.
Reload the area again and pick up Numen's Rune, Hoslow's Petal Whip, and Diallos's Mask from the ground.
Encountered in Jarburg, which lies below the cliff beyond the Carian Study Hall. Talk to him and answer that you'll be the new Potentate.
Reload the area and talk to him about picking flowers in the village.
Reload the area and exhaust his dialogue about Alexander (after meeting Alexander).
Reload the area and talk to him about poachers (after speaking to Diallos in Roundtable Hold the second time).
After Diallos relocates to Jarburg, talk to Jar-Bairn about the new potentate.
Reload the area five times to trigger the village attack. Talk to Jar-Bairn and the dying Diallos; it doesn't matter how you respond.
Reload the area and talk to him as he collects Diallos's remains.
After dueling Alexander, talk to Jar-Bairn and give him Alexander's Insides. Exhaust his dialogue, then reload the area to find the Companion Jar on the porch.
First met on the southern hillside near Saintsbridge. Select "Help him out", then free him for the Triumphant Delight gesture. Talk to him afterward to receive an Exalted Flesh.
Talk to him in Gael Tunnel. Take the spiritspring near some wolves while facing northeast to find the entrance.
Talk to him in Redmane Castle during the Radahn festival.
After killing Radahn, exhaust his dialogue on the dune with the site of grace.

Find Alexander near the cliff overlooking Jarburg. Throw an Oil Pot at him and help him out to receive the Triumphant Delight gesture (if not obtained). Talk to him afterward to receive Exalted Flesh x3.
Talk to him in the lava south of Fort Laiedd to receive the Jar helm.

Alexander will be waiting for you on a floating platform past the Dragon Temple Lift. Exhaust his dialogue to duel him, then talk to him after the fight to receive Shard of Alexander and Alexander's Innards.
Talk to Yura below the arched ruin at Seaside Ruins, or the arched ruin at Murkwater Coast after killing Bloody Finger Nerijus.
Kill Flying Dragon Agheel to obtain a Dragon Heart.
If you die, you can exhaust his dialogue at Seaside Ruins. His summon sign will then be available near a flat ruin in the lake.
Talk to him at Seaside Ruins after slaying the dragon.
Help Yura kill the Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin on the bridge outside the Academy of Raya Lucaria for Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists.

links.label: Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists

steps.text: Talk to him afterward to receive a Smithing Stone [5], then exhaust his dialogue.
Talk to him in the Second Church of Marika, then loot the Nagakiba from his corpse.
Shortly after, you'll be invaded by Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger. Kill her to obtain the Purifying Crystal Tear and Eleonora's Poleblade.
Exhaust Shabriri's dialogue near Zamor Ruins (appearing as Yura), then kill him to obtain the Ronin's Set.
Note: If you've inherited the frenzied flame, you'll find the set at his spot.
Talk to him in Church of Irith and spare him 10 runes. Select "Talk", then speak to him about the glintstone key.
After becoming Sellen's apprentice, talk to him about Sellen.
You can attempt to give him your first Academy Glintstone Key, but he'll refuse it.
Pick up an Academy Glintstone Key from a chandelier at the end of the rooftop section in Academy of Raya Lucaria.
Give him the glintstone key to learn the Erudition gesture.
Reload the area to find a scarab in the church. Kill it to obtain Ash of War: Thops's Barrier.
Find him outside the Schoolhouse Classroom. Loot Thops's Bell Bearing, Academy Glintstone Staff, and Thops's Barrier from his corpse.
After killing Radahn and Mohg, talk to her at the Cocoon of the Empyrean.
Talk to her at the Highroad Cross.
After talking to Hornsent, ask her about the hornsent.
After encountering Dryleaf Dane, ask her about the silent monk.
After Miquella's charm breaks, exhaust her dialogue and suggest the hornsent.
Reload the area and talk to her after Hornsent has left the Highroad Cross.
On the stairs to the Storehouse, you'll find two summon signs:
Use the red summon sign and kill Hornsent for the Falx and the Hornsent Set.
Talk to her to receive the Lacerating Crossed-Tree, then speak to her again.
Talk to her after reloading the area, and she'll name Ansbach as her next target. (If you missed the summon signs, she'll instead target Ansbach after you kill Messmer.)
After Ansbach leaves the Shadow Keep, you'll find two summon signs in his room:
Use the red summon sign and kill Ansbach for Ansbach's Set and Ansbach's Longbow.
If you didn't receive the Letter for Freyja from Ansbach before he left, you can find it at his spot.
Talk to her to receive the Retaliatory Crossed-Tree.
Leda appears in a mandatory NPC fight in Enir-Ilim. Kill her and her allies for Leda's Sword.
Pick up Leda's Armor from her corpse beyond the room.
Pick up the Monk's Missive and May the Best Win gesture near the Highroad Cross.
Dane is encountered at Moorth Ruins. Challenge him by using the May the Best Win gesture near him. After you beat him, pick up the Dryleaf Arts and Dane's Hat next to the cross.
After killing Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim, pick up Dane's Footwork from his corpse.
Exhaust his dialogue at the Three-Path Cross to receive the Cross Map.
After receiving a Scorpion Stew from Hornsent Grandam, give it to Hornsent, then talk to him to receive Furnace Visage x3.
Obtain another Scorpion Stew from Hornsent Grandam and attempt to give it to Hornsent.
Talk to him at the Highroad Cross to receive the New Cross Map. You'll get both maps if it's your first time talking to him.
After Miquella's charm breaks, exhaust his dialogue until he leaves the Highroad Cross.

After speaking with Leda when Hornsent is absent, two summon signs appear on the stairs to the Storehouse. Use the gold summon sign and help Hornsent defeat Leda for Ash of War: Swift Slash and Leda's Rune.
Before facing Messmer, choose how you want to finish the questline:
Summon Hornsent to kill Messmer:
After killing Messmer, exhaust Hornsent's dialogue in Messmer's chamber or at the Highroad Cross.
Hornsent invades on the staircase before Romina. Kill him for the Falx and the Hornsent Set.
Kill Messmer without summoning Hornsent:
After killing Messmer, exhaust Hornsent's dialogue in Messmer's chamber or at the Highroad Cross.
After killing Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim, loot the Falx and the Hornsent Set from his corpse.
Loot the Storeroom Key up a ladder in the room near the top of the waterfall in Belurat.
Unlock the storeroom near the Small Private Altar and exhaust her dialogue.
Kill the Divine Beast Dancing Lion to obtain the Divine Beast Head.
Exhaust her dialogue while wearing the Divine Beast Head to receive Watchful Spirit.
After reloading the area, she gives an infinite amount of Scorpion Stew when talked to (but only one can be held at a time).
Talk to her after killing Messmer to receive a Gourmet Scorpion Stew.
Exhaust her dialogue, then reload the area to find a Gourmet Scorpion Stew in front of her.
Exhaust her dialogue at the Three-Path Cross.
If you summon Freyja for the Divine Beast Dancing Lion or Rugalea the Great Red Bear and successfully kill the boss, ask her about the damage to her helm, then ask about that other man.
Talk to her after Miquella's charm breaks. If you haven't been to the Shadow Keep, you will also need to ask what she intends to look into. Optionally, ask her what if she becomes the enemy.
Talk to Freyja in a room on the seventh floor of the Storehouse.
After receiving the Letter for Freyja from Ansbach, give her the letter, then talk to her to receive the Golden Lion Shield.
Note: If you want to exclude her from the fight in Enir-Ilim, you must kill her before reloading the area.
After killing Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim, loot Freyja's Greatsword and Freyja's Set from Freyja's corpse.
Exhaust his dialogue at the Main Gate Cross.
After reloading the area, ask him about the person in verdigris armor.
After touching the cross in Belurat, talk to him about the cross at the tower.
After touching the Scaduview cross in Scadu Altus, talk to him about the cross where the eye was abandoned.
After touching the cross in Cerulean Coast, talk to him about the cross at the coast.
After talking about the Belurat and Scaduview crosses, he reaches a conclusion about Miquella's intentions.
Talk to him after Miquella's charm breaks.
Exhaust his dialogue in a room on the first floor of the Storehouse.
Loot the Secret Rite Scroll from the fourth floor, accessible via a staircase outside leading down.
After speaking to Freyja on the seventh floor, talk to Ansbach about Freyja's decision.
Give him the Secret Rite Scroll and exhaust his dialogue. Talk to him after reloading the area to receive the Letter for Freyja.
After receiving the reward from Freyja, talk to Ansbach and pass on Freyja's message.

After killing Messmer, or if you helped Leda kill Hornsent, use the gold summon sign in Ansbach's room and help him defeat Leda for Ansbach's Longbow and Leda's Rune. This step is skipped if you helped Hornsent defeat Leda.
If you summoned Ansbach for Leda and her allies, he appears at the top of the last lift in Enir-Ilim. Ask him about Mohg's death. If you also summoned Thiollier, you can also ask him about Thiollier.
After killing Promised Consort Radahn and reloading the area, pick up Ansbach's Set, Obsidian Lamina, and Furious Blade of Ansbach from his corpse.
Interact with the Forager Brood to receive a cookbook from each:
Forager Brood Cookbook [1]: Received from the Forager Brood on the cliff near the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.
Forager Brood Cookbook [2]: Received from the Forager Brood on the hill south-southeast of Cliffroad Terminus.
Forager Brood Cookbook [3]: Received from the Forager Brood in the woods past Ellac River Downstream.
Forager Brood Cookbook [4]: Received from the Forager Brood near the Church of the Crusade after you heal it with a Warming Stone.
Forager Brood Cookbook [5]: Received from the Forager Brood in the poison swamp past a short tunnel north-northeast of Moorth Ruins.
Forager Brood Cookbook [6]: Received from the Forager Brood on top of the tunnel that leads to the Church District.
Forager Brood Cookbook [7]: Received from Moore after you heal the wounded Forager Brood by the Church of the Crusade.
Buy an item from him to unlock some repeatable dialogue.
Talk to him after Miquella's charm breaks and you'll be faced with three options:
Put it behind you:
Note: The Forager Brood remain, but Moore disappears and later returns as one of Leda's allies in the Enir-Ilim fight.
After killing Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim, loot Moore's Bell Bearing, the Verdigris Greatshield, and the Verdigris Set from his corpse in the arena.
Remain sad forever:
Note: The Forager Brood disappear and Moore is excluded from the fight in Enir-Ilim.
Moore dies next to the Forager Brood by the Church of the Crusade. Loot Moore's Bell Bearing, the Verdigris Greatshield, and the Verdigris Set from his corpse.
I don't know:
Note: Moore remains at his shop, and the choice is delayed until you select another option. Pick this if you don't have the first six cookbooks and haven't spoken to Thiollier yet.

If you don't make the choice before fighting Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim, you'll have to kill him for his loot. Kill two of the Forager Brood to cause him to invade, then finish him off. His bell bearing can then be found where he usually sits.
Talk to Thiollier at the Pillar Path Cross.
Talk to Moore at the Main Gate Cross to receive the Black Syrup.
Give Thiollier the Black Syrup, ask him about it, then tell him that you're weary of life to receive Thiollier's Concoction.
Talk to him after Miquella's charm breaks.
Talk to him after reloading the area twice, or (if you've interacted with St. Trina) tell him St. Trina's whereabouts.
Talk to him at the Garden of Deep Purple.
After imbibing St. Trina's nectar four times, talk to him and attempt to pass on St. Trina's words twice.
Reload the area to be invaded by Thiollier. Defeat him to obtain St. Trina's Smile.
After imbibing St. Trina's nectar two more times, talk to him and pass on St. Trina's words.
After killing Promised Consort Radahn and reloading the area, pick up Thiollier's Hidden Needle and Thiollier's Set from his corpse.
Talk to him near the Pillar Path Waypoint grace.
On the cliff overlooking the first Jagged Peak Drake, you can find a message left by Igon.
After killing the Jagged Peak Drake (fighting another), talk to Igon to receive Igon's Furled Finger.
Kill Bayle the Dread with or without his help.
Return to him and loot Igon's Greatbow, Igon's Set, and Igon's Bell Bearing from his corpse.
If you received Igon's Furled Finger, his bow comes equipped with a unique ash of war. You can remove it to make Ash of War: Igon's Drake Hunt available for compatible bows.

links.label: Ash of War: Igon's Drake Hunt

steps.text: Talk to her at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion and agree to devour draconic essence to receive an Ancient Dragon's Blessing. You can ask for power to receive more until you either kill Bayle or give her Thiollier's Concoction (but only one can be held at a time).
Talk to her again and ask her about Bayle.
After killing the Jagged Peak Drake (fighting another), ask her about Igon.
Choose how you want to conclude Florissax's questline:
Do nothing:
After killing Bayle, pick up Priestess Heart and Flowerstone Gavel from where she stood.
Use Thiollier's concoction:
Pass time until she appears at night, then use Thiollier's concoction on her.
Pass time again until she wakes back up, then talk to her.
Talk to her after killing Bayle to be rewarded with Dragonbolt of Florissax.
Confess to putting her to sleep, then talk to her again and choose to take her with you to obtain Ancient Dragon Florissax.
Talk to him in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr to receive the Hole-Laden Necklace and the Ruins Map.
Exhaust his dialogue to unlock his inventory, then ask him about glintstone sorcery.
After speaking to Jolan, ask Ymir about the knight in black armor.
After sounding the hanging bell in either of the two finger ruins, talk to him to receive Ruins Map (2nd) and Beloved Stardust.
Ask him about the nature of the world and about Miquella.
Reload the area to find him in the graveyard outside. Listen to his monologue or sound the next bell to make him return to his chair.
After sounding the hanging bell in the other finger ruins, talk to him to receive Ruins Map (3rd), then ask about the nature of the world.
Reload the area, then move Ymir's chair to discover a ladder to the third finger ruins, where you'll be invaded by Swordhand of Night Anna. Kill her to obtain the Claws of Night.
Sound the hanging bell at the end of the ruins and kill Metyr, Mother of Fingers.
Interact with Ymir's chair to be invaded by Swordhand of Night Jolan. Defeat her, then kill Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers for Ymir's Bell Bearing, Maternal Staff, and the High Priest Set.
Pick up Cherishing Fingers from Yuri's grave outside the cathedral.
After speaking to Ymir in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, talk to Jolan by a pillar in the room.
Talk to her after receiving the second ruins map from Ymir.
Exhaust her dialogue after sounding both hanging bells.
After killing Anna in the ruins below the cathedral, tell Jolan that you were attacked by a Swordhand of Night underground.
After defeating both Jolan and Ymir, reload the area to find her slumped against the pillar from earlier:
Use Iris of Grace:
Use an Iris of Grace to obtain Swordhand of Night Jolan.
Interact with the puppet at the top of Rabbath's Rise and usher Anna into the ashes to obtain Jolan and Anna.

Note: The puppet can only be used if you've given Jolan the Iris of Grace in the same playthrough. Anna cannot be combined with Jolan's ashes from a previous NG cycle, and Jolan and Anna cannot be separated after entering NG+.
Use Iris of Occultation:
Use an Iris of Occultation to obtain the Sword of Night.
Queelign invades in Belurat's plaza and the Church of the Crusade. Defeat him in either location to obtain the Crusade Insignia.
Afterward, defeat him in the other location to obtain Ash of War: Flame Skewer and the Prayer Room Key.
Unlock the Prayer Room in the Church District to find Queelign curled up on the floor:
Use Iris of Grace:
Use an Iris of Grace to obtain Fire Knight Queelign.
Use Iris of Occultation:
Use an Iris of Occultation to obtain Queelign's Greatsword.
